reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: FC Porto are favoured at 48%, against 28% for SSC Napoli and 24% for the draw. FC Porto carry 29 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: FC Porto 1.2 points per game, SSC Napoli 0.8. They average 1.5 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.43 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 67%. Across their last five, FC Porto and SSC Napoli have scored 1.6 and conceded 2.0 a game between them.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.
